name: com.nekosune.world-ui-assistant
description: Build VRChat world UI without knowing Unity UI – and learn how it works. Panels, themes, pages and no-code actions (local or synced) through small readable UdonSharp scripts; lessons with progress and badges, explain mode, glossary; a UI Doctor with one-click fixes; templates (welcome, rules, settings, teleport, credits, schedule, links with QR codes) and JSON blueprints. Open via NekoSune → World → UI Assistant.
